action: No action needed; for awareness. The article does not report the company's own advice to customers.
date_note: Qianlong gives 9 November as the day the group first identified the access; the earlier record date of 11 November came from a tracker not read in this run and is kept as the disclosure date.
exec: A jewellery retailer says its membership system and e-commerce channel were accessed without authorisation; the article gives no number affected.
plain: Hong Kong jeweller Chow Sang Sang says it found unauthorised access to its membership system and online shop. Some customer and staff personal data may have been extracted.

sources.name: qianlong.com (新商学观察), relaying the company's announcement

summary: Qianlong reports that Chow Sang Sang issued an announcement disclosing a data security incident. The group says it first identified unauthorised access to its systems on 9 November, affecting its membership system and official e-commerce channel. Some customers' and employees' personal data is at risk of having been extracted. The article gives no number of people affected and no attack method.
title: Chow Sang Sang says it detected unauthorised access to its systems

validation.note: One publisher (qianlong.com) relaying the company's announcement; the announcement itself was not read.
